title: Elohim Protocol — SSR server bundle
name: Elohim Protocol — SSR server bundle
description: Slug→blobHash pointer for the Angular SSR server bundle for the Elohim Protocol landing surface. Materialized at boot by rendering runtimes and distributed as content-addressed substrate content. The blobHash is written by the deploy pipeline (Jenkinsfile:stageSpaBlobs, kind: server); intentionally absent from this source JSON so seed-sqlite does not clobber the deploy-time value on re-seed.

metadata.author: Matthew Dowell
metadata.blobPopulatedBy: Jenkinsfile:stageSpaBlobs (root pipeline, kind: server). The elohim-app SSR server bundle is zipped + uploaded as a blob; the hash is written into db/content/elohim-host-landing-ssr.blobHash via PATCH. Intentionally absent from this source JSON so seed-sqlite does not clobber the deploy-time value on re-seed.

securityPolicy.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' 'unsafe-eval'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; font-src 'self' data:
